inputs.name: ScenarioManifestValidator.validate.file
inputs.description: The repository path of the scenario file, used only as a label because the validator never opens it. Its last segment without the .json suffix must equal the scenario id, or a schema-valid scenario reports an id error, and that label prefixes every schema error message.
